args.name: mrt_shade
args.description: Mean radiant temperature (C) of full building shade at the reference meteorology (NWS New York Heat Advisory threshold, NOAA 1991-2020 normals at LaGuardia). The zero point of the thermal cost: an edge at or below this pays nothing, which is also what an unsurveyed edge pays, so the router is never paid to leave coverage.

args.name: mrt_sun
args.description: Mean radiant temperature (C) of open full sun at the same reference meteorology. Exposure is the position between the two anchors.

args.name: sun_inflation
args.description: Extra cost at full sun exposure, as a fraction of distance. This is beta - 1 from Melnikov et al. (2022), Sci Rep 12:2441, who estimate a population mean beta of 1.16 from 408 observed path choices, so 0.16 means a metre in full sun feels 16 percent longer than a metre in shade. Defaults to 0, which switches the thermal layer off and reproduces the pre-thermal router exactly. config/condition-map.yaml sets it per person.

terms.description: Distance-inflating coefficient on thermal exposure, after Melnikov et al. (2022). Continuous rather than banded: the UTCI stress categories are too coarse to route on here, because dUTCI/dMRT is only 0.2137 at these conditions, so a whole neighbourhood falls inside one or two categories.
